purpose: Real distribution disturbance discrimination if physical provenance and licence gates pass; not streetlight fault evaluation.
activation_reason: The official record has no explicit dataset reuse license, label-generation contract, timestamp contract, or sufficient measurement-window provenance. This decision was frozen before performance access.

source_partition.fit_calibration_rule: Within Train_Data, canonical immutable block/sample id is assigned to calibration when SHA-256(id + ':v14-a-calibration') mod 5 == 0; all others are fit. If the source has no immutable id, use the canonical raw-row fingerprint excluding the label. If no stable fingerprint can be constructed without transformations, stop as NOT_EVALUABLE_UNIT_DEFINITION.
source_partition.test_access_rule: Test labels, scores, and class counts are not used for mapping, selection, preprocessing, thresholding, or comparator design.

normalization.location: Fit-partition median by documented source channel and eligible entity/block.
normalization.scale: max(1.4826 * MAD, fit fifth percentile of positive channel MADs).
normalization.missingness: No imputation; unavailable component remains unavailable.

comparator: Maximum absolute ordinary z-score across the same eligible source-native channels, with mean/standard deviation fit on the fit partition only.

calibration_selection.metric: Balanced accuracy after label semantics are verified before test access.
calibration_selection.tie_break: Higher threshold; then PMC-C3, PMC-C2, PMC-C1.
calibration_selection.constraint: No class-specific preprocessing or source-specific feature expansion.

independent_unit.definition: Dataset-defined sample or source-defined non-overlapping time block; raw minute rows are not assumed independent.
independent_unit.requirement: A block key must be documented. Otherwise numerical inference is NOT_EVALUABLE_UNIT_DEFINITION.
independent_unit.uncertainty: 2,000 stratified cluster bootstrap replicates at the independent-unit level; no row-level naive bootstrap; fewer than 20 confirmatory clusters is INSUFFICIENT_CLUSTER_COUNT.

primary_gate: NOT_EVALUABLE unless all activation gates and independent-unit definition pass. No performance success number is chosen before the verified label semantics are known.
